title: OpenAI says Iran, Russia used AI journalists, think tanks to influence Western media
key_facts: OpenAI disclosed on Thursday (8 Oct 2026) that it shut down two influence operations, one Russian and one Iranian, that used ChatGPT and other AI tools.

The Russian cluster, called 'Dark Clark', used a fake AI persona, Mia Clark, as head of a supposed Latin American think tank, the Social Research Center, to seed propaganda; content mostly aimed to harm Ukraine's reputation in Latin America.

OpenAI called it 'the most complex attempt to run a front identity that we've disrupted over the past two and a half years'; it says the think tank's local staff apparently did not know they worked for a Russian group.
Examples: a false TikTok claim in March about Ecuador recruiting fighters for Ukraine, a fake audio clip of the Ukrainian consul, and a fake audio clip in Bolivia in May that drew an official denial.

The Iranian operation created at least seven fake journalist personas; OpenAI found almost 100 articles under their bylines across about a dozen small to medium online outlets, mostly on the US-Iran war, with little social media reaction.
OpenAI did not attribute the Iranian activity to a specific actor, saying it resembled a for-hire influence campaign.
OpenAI rated the Russian campaign 5 and the Iranian 4 on a 1-6 impact scale; the article says few campaigns rise above 1 or 2.
quote_evidence: OpenAI called it “the most complex attempt to run a front identity that we’ve disrupted over the past two and a half years.”
Operators created at least seven different fake journalist personas who managed to place dozens of stories online through legitimate media organizations.
OpenAI rated the Russian campaign a 5 and the Iranian campaign a 4, indicating they were significantly more successful in breaking through to mainstream audiences
why_it_matters_hint: AI-made journalists and think tanks got stories into real outlets and drew official denials, but the findings are OpenAI's own.
event_date: Disclosed 8 Oct 2026; activity March to May 2026 and later
notes: OpenAI's own report was not opened; everything comes from CyberScoop's account.
